foundation: Barrot V3 execution, security, verification and preservation

prior_security_successor.limitation: Its scheduler workflow retained contents/actions write permissions and committed queue state to main; this successor disables that workflow pending a durable non-main state store.

confirmed_main_findings.detail: Manual workflow had contents:write, DATABRICKS_TOKEN reference, workspace.barrot.brain query and git push. Current-tree dump files measured 353950 and 296323 bytes. Individual records were not inspected.
Manual workflow exposed mode=all, max_prs=0 (unlimited), dry_run=false default, branch update and merge operations.
15-minute schedule plus manual dispatch; contents/actions write; queue commit and push to main. This is a main-branch automated writer even if dispatched workflows are allowlisted.
Scheduled, workflow_run and manual triggers; contents:write; generated analysis files committed and pushed to main.

Main is two commits ahead of prior security base 5e82b272. Intervening changed paths are AUTONOMOUS_DEPLOYMENT_REPORT.md and ping-pongings/knowledge-base/sentiment_shift.json. New branch starts from 91b66 and preserves both.

proposed_controls: Disable public brain-corpus workflow with empty permissions and false job guard.
Replace exporter script with inert status-only entry point that reads no credentials, makes no network request and writes no files.
Remove brain_corpus/dump.json and brain_corpus/dump.md from proposed current tree without rewriting history.
Disable manual merge queue and remove merge/update/comment capabilities.
Make Cross Analysis contents:read only, disable persistent Git pushes and retain outputs as bounded 30-day workflow artifacts.
Disable scheduled and manual Scheduler Tick entirely until durable non-main state storage and approval semantics are separately reviewed.
Retain the local scheduler's input-free read-only workflow allowlist; regression test asserts the active scheduler workflow cannot write, dispatch or push.
Register four containment regression suites in core CI.

findings.detail: CryptoETF.today reports five spot products and says only one of five had reported for Nov 2, with no net creation/redemption in that one fund and four funds still partial. TheXRPInvestor reports a different 12-product universe including spot, derivatives and index products and $1.49B AUM. These universes and reporting states are not comparable; no canonical aggregate daily flow is promoted.
Third-party tracker projects Nov 4 2026 14:46 UTC if validator support remains above threshold. This is not verified activation; the validated-ledger EnableAmendment sequence must be observed.
The permission issue concerns issued trust-line tokens and MPTs; it does not change native XRP supply. Issuers should not delegate PaymentBurn until the amendment is active.

platform_status.note: SBI's external Claude relationship is not a Barrot integration.

validation.inherited_source_pr_ci: PR #1559 exact head passed 360 tests + 8 subtests; this does not verify the new head.

residual_risks: Current-main public corpus exposure remains active until this proposal is reviewed and merged.
Removing current-tree dumps does not erase historical Git objects, forks, caches or external copies.
Individual corpus record sensitivity remains unclassified; no records were inspected.
Scheduler automation is intentionally disabled in this proposal; queue entries are not autonomously fired until a safe durable state store is designed.
Branch-protection required-check enforcement remains unverified because administrative API access returned 403 and the visible ruleset is enforcement-disabled.
GitHub Actions artifact retention is 30 days, not a permanent research archive.

Inspect the PR diff and verify all changes are limited to intended containment paths plus regression tests and handoff.
Keep PR draft/unmerged pending human review and explicit merge authorization.
Build a durable non-main scheduler state store before restoring unattended scheduling.
Verify fixCleanup3_4_0 by observing the actual validated-ledger EnableAmendment transaction after the projected window.
Reconcile ETF provider universe, T+1 reporting and holdings-delta methodology before using ETF flows as model features.
Continue contract-level derivatives reconciliation and immutable fixed-horizon feature-store work.
